mentions.name: Effect-based SML runtime
mentions.description: A new Standard ML (SML) runtime that uses effect-based IO, eliminating function colouring so synchronous and asynchronous code can share a single calling convention.
mentions.source_excerpt: A new SML runtime with effect based IO (no function colouring).
